boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Named places for studying, creating, gathering, reflection, music, and campus wayfinding on Tufts’ Medford/Somerville campus.

cards.title: Choose a Tisch study zone
cards.subtitle: 35 Professors Row, Medford/Somerville campus
cards.notes: Pick a quiet, silent, or collaborative floor based on your work, then reserve a group room through Reserve Tufts if you need one.
cards.short_summary: The main library offers carrels, tables, and reservable group-study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Tisch Library documents individual, collaborative, quiet, and silent study spaces, plus reservable group-study rooms.
cards.source_title: Studying in the Library | Tisch Library
cards.access_notes: Late-night entry requires a current Tufts ID; room reservations are handled through Reserve Tufts.

cards.title: Make a project in the Digital Design Studio
cards.subtitle: Tisch Library, third floor
cards.notes: Use the available design workstations and modular tables for a media project, and book the recording room when you need audio or video capture.
cards.short_summary: A Tisch Library creative workspace for design, collaboration, and media making.
cards.evidence_claim: Tisch Library identifies the Digital Design Studio as a third-floor space with design computers, modular tables, recording-room reservations, and fabrication services.
cards.source_title: Top Five Underutilized Library Study Spaces for Finals | Tisch Library
cards.access_notes: Some equipment and the recording room require advance coordination or a reservation.

cards.title: Bring a data question to the Medford Data Lab
cards.subtitle: Tisch Library, Room 203
cards.notes: Use the computing lab during Tisch hours and connect with Data Lab support when your coursework needs help with data, code, or visualization.
cards.short_summary: A Tisch-based data-support and computing space.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts lists the Medford Data Lab in Tisch Library Room 203 and states that its computing lab is open whenever the library is open.
cards.source_title: Locations & Hours | Data Lab at Tufts
cards.access_notes: The computing lab follows Tisch Library hours; support availability may differ.

cards.title: Work near Tufts history in the archives
cards.subtitle: Tisch Library, Ground Level
cards.notes: Plan a research stop around the archives’ materials, and use the ground-level tables or carrels for focused reading before or after your visit.
cards.short_summary: Tufts’ archives and manuscripts repository is located on Tisch’s Ground Level.
cards.evidence_claim: Tisch Library identifies Digital Collections and Archives as Tufts’ archives and manuscripts repository on the Ground Level.
cards.source_title: Top Five Underutilized Library Study Spaces for Finals | Tisch Library
cards.access_notes: Consult the archives and library guidance before requesting materials or planning research access.

cards.title: Study with scores at Lilly Music Library
cards.subtitle: Granoff Music Center, Room M030
cards.notes: Browse music books, scores, and recordings, then use the library’s listed study areas for a quieter music-focused work session.
cards.short_summary: A music-library branch with scores, recordings, listening stations, and study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts Music states that Lilly Music Library is in the Granoff Music Center and has listening stations and comfortable study areas open to students.
cards.source_title: Lilly Music Library | Department of Music
cards.access_notes: Library hours vary; check the library’s current-hours page before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Elizabeth Van Huysen Mayer Campus Center
cards.title: Coordinate at the Campus Center
cards.subtitle: Professors Row, Medford/Somerville campus
cards.notes: Use the building’s meeting areas, dining options, and student-organization offices as a practical place to meet between campus commitments.
cards.short_summary: A centrally located facility with meeting space, student offices, dining, and services.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts describes the Mayer Campus Center as a central campus facility with meeting rooms, student-organization offices, dining options, and services.
cards.source_title: Campus Center Directory and Hours | AS&E Students
cards.access_notes: Published building hours are subject to holiday changes; check the current Campus Center page.

cards.title: Visit Goddard Chapel thoughtfully
cards.subtitle: 3 The Green, Medford/Somerville campus
cards.notes: Check the chapel schedule before going, then take time with the historic space while respecting worship services, reflection, and programmed events.
cards.short_summary: A historic chapel at the center of Tufts’ spiritual and ethical life.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts Chaplaincy states that Goddard Chapel, dedicated in 1883, serves as a center for spiritual and ethical life on campus.
cards.source_title: Goddard Chapel History | Tufts University Chaplaincy
cards.access_notes: Respect scheduled services and events; the chapel may not be available during programming.

cards.title: Locate the Interfaith Center
cards.subtitle: 58 Winthrop Street, Medford/Somerville campus
cards.notes: Contact the University Chaplaincy before planning a visit, especially if you need a spiritual-life conversation, program information, or space guidance.
cards.short_summary: A named Chaplaincy location serving the Tufts community.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts University Chaplaincy lists the Interfaith Center at 58 Winthrop Street and describes its work with Tufts students and communities.
cards.access_notes: Contact the Chaplaincy for current hours and any access arrangements.

cards.entity_name: Perry and Marty Granoff Music Center
cards.title: Check the Granoff performance calendar
cards.subtitle: 20 Talbot Avenue, Medford/Somerville campus
cards.notes: Look for a department concert or event before you go, then use the listed venue information to plan your arrival and entry.
cards.short_summary: Tufts’ music facility includes performance halls, rehearsal spaces, classrooms, and the music library.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts Music identifies Granoff as the home of its Music Department and describes its performance halls, classrooms, rehearsal spaces, and Lilly Music Library.
cards.source_title: Granoff Music Center | Department of Music
cards.access_notes: Public entry depends on the scheduled event and venue instructions.

cards.title: Use Memorial Steps as a campus landmark
cards.subtitle: College Avenue entrance, Medford/Somerville campus
cards.notes: Build the steps into a campus walk and pause at the commemorative plaques; use marked routes and caution in wet or winter conditions.
cards.short_summary: A historic 1929 stairway and campus memorial at Tufts’ College Avenue entrance.
cards.evidence_claim: Tufts Now identifies the Memorial Steps as a 1929 campus landmark built to commemorate Tufts war dead and later restored.
cards.source_title: A New Life for Memorial Steps | Tufts Now
cards.access_notes: Use care on stairs, especially in rain, snow, or icy conditions.
